title: Audit Logging Requirement
description: Defines the required configuration for comprehensive audit logging of system events and financial transactions

log-level.description: Minimum log level captured in the audit trail

retention-days.description: Number of days audit logs must be retained

immutable-storage.description: Whether audit logs must be written to immutable (write-once) storage

events.description: Event categories that must be audited

alert-on-anomaly.description: Whether anomalous activity triggers real-time alerts
